facets.description: Office365 createEvent (office365calendar CalendarService.ts ~73-77) always uses destinationCalendar[0].externalId instead of the destination matching the creating credential
Lark createEvent (larkcalendar CalendarService.ts ~128-129) always uses destinationCalendar[0].externalId
Lark createAttendees (larkcalendar CalendarService.ts ~164-165) always uses destinationCalendar[0].externalId
BaseCalendarService createEvent (packages/lib/CalendarService.ts ~156-164) filters calendars by destinationCalendar[0].externalId
Stored booking reference externalId (from CalendarManager/destination.externalId) disagrees with the calendar the event was actually created on, breaking later updates/deletes
